verdict.rationale: Otter's homepage directly claims pre-meeting briefing documents covering prior discussions, action items, and updates. That matches the story's core of walking in prepped with past context and open threads. Supporting docs add organization by client or opportunity and natural-language search of past calls. missing for 10: explicit documentation that briefs are matched to past meetings with the same attendees, detail on how briefs are generated and delivered (timing, calendar trigger), and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the briefing feature.

support.subject: As a founder, I walk into each meeting prepped — the tool surfaces past meetings with the same people and a brief of open threads before the call

citations.quote: Have briefing documents delivered before your meeting with all the prior discussions, action items, and updates you need.
Keep meetings and notes organized by client, opportunity, or topic to easily revisit key highlights and follow-ups.
Find key insights from past calls, documents, and more using natural-language.
